scope: Native evidence for the Node 22.23.4 base pinned by production-runtime-assessment.json. Versus the base recorded in the staging-*-runtime-assessment.json evidence, nodejs/bin/node is the only changed ELF; every other ELF hash is unchanged and stays covered by that evidence.

changed_layers.2: tzdata 2026c-0+deb13u1 to 2026e-0+deb13u1 (zoneinfo data, changelogs, dpkg status); no ELF.
changed_layers.3: tzdata-legacy 2026c-0+deb13u1 to 2026e-0+deb13u1 (same kind of files); no ELF.
changed_layers.12: ca-certificates 20250419 to 20250419+deb13u1: etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt goes from 150 to 148 certificates, removing CN=AAA Certificate Services,O=Comodo CA Limited and CN=emSign ECC Root CA - G3; no ELF.

system_ca_bundle_use: None found. This node binary defaults to its bundled root store (its --use-bundled-ca help text says (default)). It reads the system bundle named by SSL_CERT_FILE only with --use-openssl-ca, --use-system-ca, NODE_USE_SYSTEM_CA=1 or tls.getCACertificates('system'); no HID Dockerfile, service, script, workflow or infra file, and no installed dependency of the services' current lockfiles, uses any of these, NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS or /etc/ssl.

node_binary.signer_listed_in: Release keys in README.md of node-v22.23.3.tar.xz (the previously pinned source) and node-v22.23.4.tar.xz.

methods.layers: Index, platform manifests, configs and the four differing layer blobs fetched by digest from gcr.io/distroless/nodejs22-debian13 and checked against those digests. Every entry of each differing layer was compared with the layer at the same position in the previous manifest; the other 18 layers have identical digests.
methods.release_identity: SHASUMS256.txt and its detached .sig and clearsigned .asc each verify with the key of that fingerprint; the release tarball and source tarball hashes equal the listed values.
methods.forbidden_glibc_imports: Undefined .dynsym and .symtab names read with elf_imports() from scripts/assess-staging-runtime.py (undefined_imports counts them) that are in its forbidden list: strfmon, strfmon_l, __strfmon_l, ns_printrr, ns_printrrf, fp_nquery.
methods.aligned_new_symbols: .dynsym and .symtab names containing align_val_t (C++17 aligned new and delete).
methods.pbds_strings: Occurrences of pb_ds, __gnu_pbds or binary_heap in the binary's bytes; strfmon, ns_printrr and fp_nquery also occur 0 times.
methods.source_files_inspected: Regular files in the source tarball whose extension is .c, .cc, .cpp, .h, .hpp, .gyp or .gypi; the same rule gives the recorded 11700 for node-v22.23.3.tar.xz. pattern_hits lists those containing a forbidden glibc name, pb_ds, __gnu_pbds or binary_heap; no other file in the tarball contains one either.
